name: RAR sales_agent
description: A sales agent may act in the regions its attestation vouches for. A request the attested regions do not cover is denied; a request made by a client alone (no person) that covers EMEA is narrowed to EMEA.

rules.name: narrow a client-only request to EMEA
rules.description: No person stands behind a client-credentials request, so it is held to the home region.

rules.name: permit the attested regions
rules.description: The requested regions are within the attestation's (a substring test on the space-joined lists, as the processor orders them).
